referencePolicy: Dental SaaS is the UI and business-contract reference. SaaS authentication, HTTP transport, Worker and database code are excluded; all runtime clinic requests go through Dental OS ClinicClient.

imports.adaptation: SaaS JSX and styling retained. Added only lifecycle reporting and a conditional same-command retry control inside the existing error state for uncertain writes.

contractReferences.usedFor: Page title/subtitle, refresh placement, loading/error handling, and save/reload behavior. SaaS Firebase/HTTP calls were not copied.
GET list, POST create, PUT update routes and receipt envelope. Runtime adapter replaced with ClinicClient commands.
TreatmentProtocol, TreatmentProtocolInput, ProtocolStage and TreatmentScope types.
Existing shared page, header, card and inline page-refresh presentation package.
Shared SaaS workspace visual tokens and clinic styles already present in the shared package.
Exact SaaS page refresh and snackbar CSS declarations copied into the shared package so the imported shared components retain their SaaS appearance.

uiParity.listAndDetail: Uses the SaaS catalogue columns, detail page, stage rows, default prices, canal/mobility options, modal and soft-retire confirmation.
uiParity.stageOrdering: SaaS UI has no manual reorder control; current displayed order is preserved when saved. No new reorder control was introduced.
uiParity.previewPreserved: The M13 company.dental.treatment-protocols package and source were not changed; only its thumbnail was copied into this new M17 app.

excluded: direct app-owned HTTP, credential storage, local business database and offline write queue
